	definition:
		foundCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(b: BankCard|b.CardID = cardid),
		cardExists: Boolean = if BankCard.allInstance()->exists(b: BankCard|b.CardID = cardid) 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(o: BankCard|o.CardID)
	postcondition:
		cardExists = true and
		self.CardIDValidated = true and
